name: gemini-advisor
description: A Gemini advisor the model calls by itself: Gemini reads the conversation and the model's message and answers with a second opinion. /gemini-advisor sets on/off, the model and the tier. Needs function hooks (early access).

apiKey.title: Gemini API key
apiKey.description: Leave empty to use the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable.

tier.title: Gemini tier
tier.description: free: Google may use the conversation to improve its products and human reviewers may read it. paid: a billing-enabled key. /gemini-advisor free|paid overrides it.

model.title: Gemini model
model.description: The model that advises. /gemini-advisor model <id> overrides it.

maxInputChars.title: Maximum characters sent to Gemini
maxInputChars.description: Above it the longest tool outputs of the conversation are cut to their head and tail before sending.

maxOutputTokens.title: Maximum advice tokens
maxOutputTokens.description: The longest advice Gemini may write, thinking included.
